meta.name: linkedin-formats
meta.description: Select the optimal LinkedIn content format and follow format-specific guidelines. Use when the user asks about carousels, video posts, text posts, polls, LinkedIn newsletters, format selection, reach multipliers, or content format specs. Do NOT use for post writing/structure (use storytelling) or posting schedule (use scheduling).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 选择 LinkedIn 内容格式，提升帖子表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果发 LinkedIn 前纠结哪种格式效果更好
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best LinkedIn content format to boost post performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure which LinkedIn format drives better engagement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你挑选适合目标的 LinkedIn 帖子形式（如轮播、纯文本、视频），并给出该形式的具体制作要点，比如幻灯片数量、字数、字幕要求。它还会优先参考 ColdIQ 的实时数据来判断哪种形式当前效果更好。
howto.when: 当你提到轮播、视频、投票等 LinkedIn 内容格式或相关问题时触发；不会用于帖子写作或发布计划安排。

say.text: 我想做一个 LinkedIn 轮播，该注意什么？
say.note: Claude 会给出轮播的页数、封面和 CTA 等要点。

say.text: 帮我选个格式：分享我的创业失败故事，用哪种帖子好？
say.note: Claude 会根据目标推荐合适的格式。

say.text: 我有个博客链接，怎么发到 LinkedIn 不降权重？
say.note: Claude 会建议把链接放第一条评论。

howto.what_en: Claude helps choose the best LinkedIn format (carousel, text, video) for your goal and gives format-specific specs (slide count, character limit, captions). It checks ColdIQ live data to prefer the currently winning format.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention LinkedIn formats like carousel, video, poll, or related questions. Not for post writing or scheduling.

say_en.text: I want to make a LinkedIn carousel. What should I pay attention to?
say_en.note: Claude explains slide count, cover, and CTA.

say_en.text: Help me choose a format for my startup failure story. Which post type?
say_en.note: Claude suggests a text post and gives writing tips.

say_en.text: I have a blog link. How do I share it on LinkedIn without killing reach?
say_en.note: Claude suggests a text post with the link in the first comment.
